packageRules.description: Exclude all @assistant-ui packages from automated updates
Keep Lexical aligned with @assistant-ui/react-lexical until the adapter supports newer releases

@sentry/react must match the @sentry/core version pinned by @sentry/electron (the renderer passes react's init into electron's init). Never bump it on its own; bump it by hand in the @sentry/electron PR.
Remind the reviewer to align @sentry/react in the same PR.
prBodyNotes: Set `@sentry/react` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` to the `@sentry/core` version listed in https://unpkg.com/@sentry/electron@{{{newVersion}}}/package.json, then run `pnpm install`. CI typecheck fails until they match.

packageRules.description: Update all bundled Kilo CLI platform packages together for manual compatibility testing.
Automatically merge minor and patch updates for GitHub Actions.
Ensure lock file maintenance PRs are never throttled

lockFileMaintenance.description: Regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml. Manual merge: native addons (electron, better-sqlite3, keytar) can break on lockfile-only bumps.
